import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    readings = inputs["readings"].copy()
    
    # Row-level validation: mark bad rows
    # Bad if: value IS NULL OR value < 0 OR value > 1000
    readings["is_bad"] = (
        readings["value"].isna() | 
        (readings["value"] < 0) | 
        (readings["value"] > 1000)
    )
    
    # Batch-level quarantine decision
    batch_stats = readings.groupby("batch_id").agg(
        total_rows=("is_bad", "size"),
        bad_rows=("is_bad", "sum")
    ).reset_index()
    batch_stats["bad_pct"] = (batch_stats["bad_rows"] * 100.0) / batch_stats["total_rows"]
    batch_stats["should_quarantine"] = batch_stats["bad_pct"] > 20.0
    
    # Merge quarantine decision back to readings
    readings = readings.merge(batch_stats[["batch_id", "should_quarantine", "bad_pct"]], on="batch_id")
    
    # Separate into three outputs
    readings_clean = pd.DataFrame()
    readings_rejects = pd.DataFrame()
    readings_quarantine = pd.DataFrame()
    
    # Process quarantined batches
    quarantined = readings[readings["should_quarantine"]]
    if len(quarantined) > 0:
        quarantined_out = quarantined[["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]].copy()
        quarantined_out["batch_reject_pct"] = quarantined.groupby("batch_id")["bad_pct"].transform(
            lambda x: np.round(x, 2)
        )
        readings_quarantine = quarantined_out
    
    # Process non-quarantined batches
    non_quarantined = readings[~readings["should_quarantine"]]
    if len(non_quarantined) > 0:
        good_rows = non_quarantined[~non_quarantined["is_bad"]]
        bad_rows = non_quarantined[non_quarantined["is_bad"]]
        
        if len(good_rows) > 0:
            readings_clean = good_rows[["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]].copy()
        
        if len(bad_rows) > 0:
            readings_rejects = bad_rows[["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]].copy()
    
    return {
        "readings_clean": readings_clean,
        "readings_rejects": readings_rejects,
        "readings_quarantine": readings_quarantine
    }
